title: Does what the chart says
detail: The measurements matched what I heard. Rare honesty.

title: Solid, a bit pricey
detail: Great build. You pay for the testing, and it shows.

title: Fast delivery, no fuss
detail: Arrived next day, double boxed. Works perfectly.

title: Replaced under warranty
detail: A port failed after a year. New unit in three days.

title: Battery lasts all week
detail: Charged on Sunday, still going Friday night.

title: Firmware update fixed it
detail: Dropouts at first. One update later, rock solid.

title: Cable is too short
detail: Great device, but the included cable is a metre. Buy a longer one.

title: Clear mids
detail: Vocals sit where they should. Bass is honest, not boosted.

title: No app needed
detail: Everything works with a button. My parents could use it.

title: Runs warm
detail: Works fine but gets warm under load. Give it some air.

title: Quiet fan
detail: I forgot it was on. That is the highest praise for a fan.

title: Case is metal
detail: Real aluminium, not painted plastic. Feels like it will last.

title: Pairing was instant
detail: Open the lid, tap once, done.

title: Wish it had USB-C
detail: Everything else is right. The port is from another decade.

title: Great for calls
detail: Colleagues stopped asking me to repeat myself.

title: Speaker fills the room
detail: Small box, big sound. Party volume without distortion.

title: Manual is thin
detail: Works well, but I had to search online for the settings.

title: Lens is sharp corner to corner
detail: Tested on a brick wall like a nerd. It passes.

title: Returned, wrong size
detail: My fault, the spec sheet was clear. Return was painless.

title: Charges the laptop too
detail: One cable for everything on the desk now.

title: Slight hiss at idle
detail: Only with sensitive earphones and at full gain. Fine otherwise.

title: Bought two
detail: One for the office, one for home. No regrets.

title: Buttons feel cheap
detail: Sound is great, the plastic buttons are not.

title: Setup took five minutes
detail: Plugged in, updated, done before the coffee was ready.
